[[File:Kote_kyram.png|thumb|right|250px|A ''kote ky'ram'']]
The '''''kote ky'ram''''', also known more simply as the '''Mandalorian death ceremony''', was a funerary ritual performed by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture in ancient times for [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] with the highest honor.

When translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]] from the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']], ''kote ky'ram'' meant "glory death," and was typically reserved for warriors who fell in battle to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or impossible odds.

The death ceremony saw the fallen warrior's body placed upon an elevated pyre, to better ensure their spirit would be able to join those of other Mandalorian paragons.

As the deceased was [[Cremation/Legends|cremated]], clan members shouted war cries and tales of their fallen comrade's deeds to the sky, before beginning a night of [[Alcohol/Legends|drunken]] celebration and feasting in the warrior's honor.<ref name="KotFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]], the only non-Mandalorian to receive the honor was the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Raze (Sith)|Raze]], who died while single-handedly rescuing a Mandalorian clan from twenty Jedi during a battle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="KotFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''kote ky'ram'' ritual was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the MMORPG [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] expansion, released [[October 27]], [[2015]].<ref name="KotFE" />
